top_signals.title: Seaway7 Starts Cable Installation at Ørsted’s Hornsea 3 Wind Farm
top_signals.summary: Seaway7 has installed the first inter-array cable at Ørsted's 2.9 GW Hornsea 3 offshore wind farm in the UK North Sea, marking the start of a major cable installation campaign.The company will transport and install more than 536 kilometers of 66kV inter-array cables…
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
